messages:
lina-cs: Heads up — Helios renewal is scheduled for signing tomorrow morning. They emailed asking to change billing entity to 'Helios Holdings Ltd' and route invoice to AP@holdings. Also want term shortened to 9 months instead of 12. Can legal/finance confirm any blockers? :eyes:

Tom-sales: ok noted. Was that requested by buyer legal or finance? Any PO or vendor code required?

lina-cs: buyer finance requested the billing entity change, buyer legal asked for 9 mo term to align with budget cycle. No PO yet, they said they can run a single invoice once signer signs.

nisha-legal: quick read — billing entity change is fine but need to ensure indemnity/notice sections still reference correct legal entity. If Helios Holdings Ltd is a different legal entity than on SOW we need a signed amendment. Also need to confirm signature authority for the new signer.

oliver-finance: from our side we need a vendor code and tax ID to put on invoice. Also note: shorter term impacts monthly ARR recognition; we need approval from RevOps for accounting treatment. Can we get the tax ID today?

lina-cs: I asked them for vendor code + tax ID, they said finance director (signer) will provide by EOD. They want to sign via our standard DocuSign link.

Tom-sales: can we accept the 9mo as a one-time exception? margin is tight but customer growth likely. If legal ok, I'll approve. Need quick turnaround — I can escalate to AM.

nisha-legal: draft amendment snippet below, we can append to master agreement as a one-paragraph amendment. If reviewer ok I'll prepare for signature:```
Amendment: Effective Date: [date]
1) Billing Entity: Customer shall be invoiced to 'Helios Holdings Ltd', VAT/TAX ID: [to be provided].
2) Term: Notwithstanding Section X, the Initial Term shall be nine (9) months.
3) All other terms remain unchanged.
```

oliver-finance: Looks fine. Add a clause: "Invoices will be addressed to Helios Holdings Ltd and remit to AP@holdings". Also add "Customer will provide vendor code and tax ID prior to invoicing".

lina-cs: adding that now. @nisha-legal can you confirm we can send amendment via DocuSign tomorrow AM and escalate to exec sign if needed?

nisha-legal: yes — I can route with an "accept amendment" checkbox and updated signature block. If signer authority unclear, include a one-line attestation field for signer's title.

bot-esign: Document created: 1755550001-Helios-Amendment. Link: https://docusign.example/abc123 (expires in 7 days)

Tom-sales: great. Lina — please confirm once their signer signs and we have vendor code/tax ID so I can confirm finance approval. If anything delays, we may need to hold to next week.

lina-cs: will do. I'll ping again when signer accepts. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
